hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q 'git push' && { echo 'git push bloqué'; exit 1; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(rm -[a-z]*r[a-z]*f|rm -[a-z]*f[a-z]*r|git reset --hard|git clean -[fdx]*f|truncate )' && { echo 'Commande destructive bloquée'; exit 1; } || exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.env\.|\.pem$|\.key$|id_rsa|id_ed25519|secrets?\.|credentials)' && { echo 'Fichier sensible détecté, modification bloquée'; exit 1; } || exit 0
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude a terminé" with title "Claude Code"'
